component.name: WeekNumber
component.summary: The ISO week number in the system tray

description.p: WeekNumber shows the current ISO week number in the panel. A click opens a two-month calendar with week numbers, public holidays for up to two countries and a time-zone clock; a right click opens the menu.
It works offline: no network, no accounts, no tracking. A non-profit project.
